known_gaps: turning the customer's words into negotiation events (and dates into YYYY-MM-DD) is done by the dialogue model; offers, counters, dates, amounts, read-back, recording, notes and the close are code
callback window validity is decided by the dialogue model from code-computed window facts (not code)
identity flow (which question, re-asks, declines) follows the dialogue model with the bank's verification results

extra rule (stateful, stage opening): Identity confirmation: only explicit confirmations count; ask at most twice (an answered customer question does not reset the count), then close not_reached/unclear. - left to the dialogue model's prompt
extra rule (computational, stage identity): Purely numeric dates of birth are read day, month, year before converting to YYYY-MM-DD. - left to the dialogue model's prompt

extra rule (stateful, stage identity): Declining the security questions: explain once that they protect the account; a second refusal or a second 'what is this about' closes not_verified/declined. - left to the dialogue model's prompt
extra rule (computational, stage negotiate): 'Next <weekday>' is that weekday in the following calendar week; 'this <weekday>' is in the current week. - left to the dialogue model's prompt

extra rule (stateful, stage negotiate): Refusing the deadline offered after a too-late date, refusing the floor, or not accepting the floor after a below-floor amount each count as a flat refusal using one persuasion attempt. - left to the dialogue model's prompt

extra rule (stateful, stage negotiate): Floor is offered only once after 'too much' (attempt 2 may name it again on the deadline); count persuasion attempts per band (early 1, late 2), never repeat a refused offer, then close no_promise/refused. - left to the dialogue model's prompt

extra rule (stateful, stage negotiate): Customer-proposed dates or amounts are never refusals; hardship (illness, death in the family, job loss) suppresses persuasion and takes precedence over rules 30 and 41, but a self-named date/amount is still recorded. - left to the dialogue model's prompt
extra rule (stateful, stage negotiate): A change of date or amount at readback invalidates the confirmation; re-check and read back again before create_promise. - left to the dialogue model's prompt
extra rule (stateful, stage global): Human request: ask once whether you can help first; transfer to general only if they insist. - left to the dialogue model's prompt
extra rule (stateful, stage global): Customer saying twice they do not want to talk closes no_promise/refused after verification, not_verified/declined before. - left to the dialogue model's prompt
extra rule (stateful, stage closing): If a transfer follows a recorded promise, close as transferred with that transfer's reason. - left to the dialogue model's prompt
checks: first security answer reaches verify_identity with the right field
no account or write call before verification
negotiation stage reached with account facts
every product's past-due amount stated in the debt statement, before any offer
